mapper.sql: SELECT w.*, s.semester_name FROM WORKLOAD w LEFT JOIN SEMESTER s ON w.semester_id = s.semester_id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO WORKLOAD ( semester_id, teacher_no, teacher_name, course_no, course_name, hour_type, notification_no, transfer_hours, actual_hours, total_hours, total_credit, actual_hour_ratio, student_count, class_name, confirm_status ) VALUES
( #{item.semesterId}, #{item.teacherNo}, #{item.teacherName}, #{item.courseNo}, #{item.courseName}, #{item.hourType}, #{item.notificationNo}, #{item.transferHours}, #{item.actualHours}, #{item.totalHours}, #{item.totalCredit}, NULL, #{item.studentCount}, #{item.className}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE WORKLOAD w SET actual_hour_ratio = CASE WHEN actual_hours IS NULL OR total_hours IS NULL OR total_hours = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(actual_hours / total_hours * 100, 2) END
mapper.select:
SELECT w.teacher_no, w.teacher_name, COUNT(*) AS total_records, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(w.confirm_status, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed_records FROM WORKLOAD w
WHERE w.teacher_no IN ( SELECT t.staff_no FROM TEACHER_DEPT td JOIN TEACHER t ON t.teacher_id = td.teacher_id WHERE td.dept_id IN ( SELECT dept_id FROM TEACHER_DEPT WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} ) )
AND w.semester_id = #{semesterId}
GROUP BY w.teacher_no, w.teacher_name ORDER BY w.teacher_name, w.teacher_no
